founder.name: Robert Garrison
founder.title: Founder & President
founder.bio: With 25 years in construction — from framing houses as a teenager to managing multi-million dollar commercial builds — Robert founded Ironclad Construction in 2009 with a simple belief: good work speaks for itself.
founder.bio2: Starting with residential renovations and custom homes, the company grew through referrals and repeat clients. Today, Ironclad is one of the most trusted general contractors in the metro area, with over 150 completed projects and a team of 40+ skilled professionals.
